lines: Ravens are the Week 3 curiosity: BAL -3.5 against Dallas at Maracanã Stadium in Rio, total 53.5, Mon 4:25 am Perth. Baltimore is 1-1 after losing 17-24 at home to New Orleans.
Atlanta opened Week 3 by hammering Green Bay 35-14 at Lambeau. Bijan Robinson went 29 car, 194 yds, 2 TD and Drake London had 9 rec, 194 yds. Both teams now 1-2.
Cleveland hosts Carolina at 1:00 am Mon Perth with the Panthers favoured on the road, CAR -2.5, total 42.5. Browns are 1-1 after a 23-19 win in Tampa.
Chiefs are double-digit road favourites in Miami, KC -10.5, total 45.5. Kansas City is 2-0 after a 33-30 overtime win over Indianapolis, Mahomes 32/47, 382 yds, 3 TD.
Bills -7 at home against the 0-2 Chargers, total 50.5. Buffalo is 2-0 after beating Detroit 41-31.
Eagles close the week Tuesday 8:15 am Perth at Chicago, PHI -4.5, total 41.5, after a 24-20 win in Tennessee.

postgame.what_decided_it: Cincinnati won the red zone and nothing else mattered. Houston went 0-4 inside the 20 and 0-4 on fourth down. The Bengals went 1-1 in the red zone and took 20-6.
standouts: Ja'Marr Chase: 7 rec, 75 yds, 2 TD after being a non-factor in the opener, per the ESPN recap.
Joe Burrow: 20/31, 207 yds, 2 TD, 0 INT. Only 5.1 yards per pass, but no turnovers and five sacks taken.
Chase Brown: 20 car, 80 yds. Tee Higgins added 5 rec for 95 yds.
postgame.division_meaning: Bengals are 2-0 and alone on top at +20. Baltimore lost 24-17 to New Orleans, Pittsburgh lost 20-3 at New England, Cleveland beat Tampa 23-19. All three sit 1-1.
postgame.the_take: Houston out-gained them 374 to 267 and Cincinnati still won by 14 without a turnover either way. An ESPN video headline says two numbers show the defense could be legit. I buy it.
